queries.query: INSERT INTO users (id, external_auth_id, email, name, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id, :externalAuthId, :email, :name, :createdAt, :updatedAt)
SELECT id, external_auth_id, email, name, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE external_auth_id = :externalAuthId LIMIT 1
SELECT id, external_auth_id, email, name, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1
UPDATE users SET email = :email, name = :name, updated_at = :updatedAt WHERE external_auth_id = :externalAuthId
UPDATE users SET email = CONCAT('deleted-', id, '@deleted.invalid'), name = 'Usuário Removido', updated_at = :updatedAt WHERE external_auth_id = :externalAuthId
INSERT INTO family_members (id, user_id, name, relation, active, created_at) VALUES (:id, :userId, :name, :relation, :active, :createdAt)
SELECT id, user_id, name, relation, active, created_at FROM family_members WHERE user_id = :userId AND (:includeInactive = true OR active = true) ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id, name, relation, active, created_at FROM family_members WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1
UPDATE family_members SET name = :name, relation = :relation, active = :active WHERE id = :id
UPDATE family_members SET active = false WHERE id = :id

INSERT INTO expenses ( id, user_id, family_member_id, category_id, installment_group_id, description, amount, expense_date, installment_number, total_installments, is_recurring, is_fixed, payment_method, notes, scope, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( :id, :userId, :familyMemberId, :categoryId, :installmentGroupId, :description, :amount, :expenseDate, :installmentNumber, :totalInstallments, :isRecurring, :isFixed, :paymentMethod, :notes, :scope, :createdAt, :updatedAt ) RETURNING id, user_id, family_member_id, category_id, installment_group_id, description, amount, expense_date, installment_number, total_installments, is_recurring, is_fixed, payment_method, notes, scope, created_at, updated_at

SELECT id, user_id, family_member_id, category_id, installment_group_id, description, amount, expense_date, installment_number, total_installments, is_recurring, is_fixed, payment_method, notes, scope, created_at, updated_at FROM expenses WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1

UPDATE expenses SET family_member_id = :familyMemberId, category_id = :categoryId, description = :description, amount = :amount, expense_date = :expenseDate, is_fixed = :isFixed, payment_method = :paymentMethod, notes = :notes, scope = :scope, updated_at = :updatedAt WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :userId RETURNING id, user_id, family_member_id, category_id, installment_group_id, description, amount, expense_date, installment_number, total_installments, is_recurring, is_fixed, payment_method, notes, scope, created_at, updated_at
DELETE FROM expenses WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :userId

INSERT INTO installment_groups ( id, user_id, description, total_amount, total_installments, first_due_date, created_at ) VALUES ( :id, :userId, :description, :totalAmount, :totalInstallments, :firstDueDate, :createdAt ) RETURNING id
SELECT user_id FROM installment_groups WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1
DELETE FROM expenses WHERE installment_group_id = :id AND user_id = :userId
DELETE FROM installment_groups WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :userId
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM family_members WHERE id = :familyMemberId AND user_id = :userId
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM expense_categories WHERE id = :categoryId AND (is_default = true OR user_id = :userId)

SELECT id, user_id, category_id, description, amount, income_date, is_recurring, notes, created_at, updated_at FROM incomes WHERE user_id = :userId AND income_date >= :startDate AND income_date < :endDate ORDER BY income_date DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id, category_id, description, amount, income_date, is_recurring, notes, created_at, updated_at FROM incomes WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO incomes ( id, user_id, category_id, description, amount, income_date, is_recurring, notes, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( :id, :userId, :categoryId, :description, :amount, :incomeDate, :isRecurring, :notes, :createdAt, :updatedAt ) RETURNING id, user_id, category_id, description, amount, income_date, is_recurring, notes, created_at, updated_at

UPDATE incomes SET category_id = :categoryId, description = :description, amount = :amount, income_date = :incomeDate, is_recurring = :isRecurring, notes = :notes, updated_at = :updatedAt WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :userId RETURNING id, user_id, category_id, description, amount, income_date, is_recurring, notes, created_at, updated_at
DELETE FROM incomes WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :userId
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM expense_categories WHERE id = :categoryId AND (is_default = true OR user_id = :userId)
